title: knowledge(events): ChangeCompany leaves triggers and trigger-event subscribers running in the calling company
summary: A knowledge article documents that ChangeCompany does not move trigger execution context to the target company; triggers and trigger-event subscribers still run in the calling company. StartSession is recommended for cross-company operations that require proper trigger handling.
key_points: ChangeCompany redirects only the data access of a record variable
Triggers, field validation and database trigger-event subscribers keep running in the calling company
Passing RunTrigger false skips trigger code, but subscribers still receive the trigger events
The recommended approach is StartSession with the company parameter, so the code runs in the target company
Direct cross-company writes should be limited to trigger-free hand-off tables owned by the extension
